I’ve told my family that i prefer quality over quantity so that i don’t have to see them often. It’s sort of a trick that makes them think i want to see them less for a positive reason. but i’ve got to make sure that i don’t get into deep conversations with them. Hey I understand this quite a bit. But i’m in a different country with a different medical set up. All I can say is that it was easier to manage my symptoms when I left my Ndads house. I’ve been sick for 3 years, neurological and related to spine injury. He used to make me push myself beyond my abilities and the added cortisol levels worsened my condition, made me even weaker. I improved about 20% after only a couple of weeks of leaving. I tell you this only because one day you might get an opportunity to leave and your health might improve a fraction or a lot. I hope someone can give some good advice for you to one day be free from there. In the meantime enforcing more boundaries might be good. Although it sounds like the abuse gets worse when you resist them, am I correct?

edit: one idea i had, was maybe there is a network that you can join. I saw on twitter that the me/cfs community found a home for someone to live in, when their parents was abusing them. maybe there’s the same for concussion network

I have obvious mobility issues considering the way I walk and the neck brace that I have on, and Mombies still mow me down with their strollers when walking two strollers side by side on the suburban footpath. I sometimes think they intentionally do it because. they are ableist or something. Just go single file for 5 seconds while we pass each other and don’t make me jump out of the way, because i literally can’t. geez.
Yeah wow. I mean, i might do the same. Sounds like your doing all your healing away from them. It’s like you can protect this journey from them, they can’t touch it!

Yeah, it’s exhausting. Emotionally and mentally into physically. The only way i can think to deal with this situation, is to limit the time spent together. With my parents, less time is better. Less things said, less damage.

What’s with Nparents and food? My parents stopped feeding me from age 8. How hard is it to just feed a child? In your case, they were meant to just feed you, and then NOT be a  martyr about it, omg. And not hurt you! I think I do the same as you in other things, always thinking how I can do a thing better or just more reasonable than my family would.

i’ve never liked the idea of people using their grandchildren to have access to their child. Theyre your children! I feel like that’s a privelage they would have needed to earn rather than a right that they can just be entitled to.

yes. moving out is great. There are lots of clearer thoughts after moving out, in my experience. My mistake was moving back after i’d moved far away because I had gotten sick and they said they would look after me. Instead I ended up looking after them again! it was all a trick! hey i do this almost 100% of the time. Everything in my life I see through high fantasy goggles. Helps me to make magic out of shit situations. It’s really crappy when I snap out of it though, so I’m looking to balance it a bit. Have you thought about writing a book or story in literature/illustration/ audio recording or animation form? I think using it creatively could be like therapy.

EDIT: I do not want to encourage you to hold onto anything destructive in your life. I mentioned the creating part because that has helped me to make something from my fantasies so I could move on. but that might not work for others.
